title: OntoRAG dataset manifest
description: Root contract a service reads to connect to a GitHub-as-storage OntoRAG dataset. All paths are POSIX, relative to the repository root.

ontorag.description: Spec version this manifest conforms to (semver-ish).

version.description: Dataset content version (bump when chunks/embeddings change).

license.description: SPDX identifier of the licence the content is distributed under, e.g. CC-BY-SA-4.0.

source_repo.description: Where the source documents come from (URL).

builder.description: Tool + version that produced this dataset.

dataset.description: Identity, version and licence of the dataset.

format.description: Media type of the graph file, e.g. text/turtle.

graph.description: Path to the RDF graph (loadable into Oxigraph/rdflib).

entity_index.description: Path to the flat NDJSON entity index derived from the graph.

prefixes.description: Path to a JSON map of prefix -> namespace used by the graph.

base_iri.description: Namespace under which the dataset mints its entity IRIs. Should be dereferenceable.

aligns_with.description: External ontologies this graph aligns to (e.g., rpg-schema catalog slugs).

counts.description: Entity counts, overall and by type (informative).

ontology.description: The knowledge graph: where it is, how it is keyed, and what it aligns to.

format.description: Media type of chunk files: application/x-ndjson.

chunks_glob.description: Glob (relative to root) matching per-document chunk NDJSON files.

chunking.description: How documents were split: strategy, target size and overlap (informative).

content.description: The retrievable text: chunk files and the sources they come from.

config.description: Path to the embedding configuration file.

vectors_glob.description: Glob matching per-document vector NDJSON files, aligned to chunks by id.

provider.description: Embedding provider used at build time, e.g. ollama. Consumers must embed queries with the same provider and model.

dim.description: Vector length. Every embedding record must have exactly this many numbers.

normalized.description: True if vectors are L2-normalized (so dot == cosine).

alignment.description: How vector records map to chunks.

embeddings.description: Dense vectors for the chunks, and how to embed queries compatibly. Optional: without it, consumers can still retrieve through the ontology and keywords, but not by vector similarity.

schema.description: Paths to the JSON Schemas describing each record type.

composition.description: The pack composition model: how the dataset decomposes into a spine plus per-source packs linked by a dependency DAG. Selection rules (access scope vs. composition) are defined by the OntoRAG Provenance Ontology: https://ontorag.org/provenance/#packs

registry.description: Path to the pack registry (id -> {title, path, requires}).

dependency.description: Predicate forming the pack dependency DAG (orp:requires between packs; dcterms:requires between their sources).

tool.description: Tool that validates and composes packs (informative).
